title: Roof: Asphalt Shingle Layering
objectives: Understand roof layer order from deck to vents
Identify flashing types and where they go

steps.title: Structure
steps.caption: Rafters/trusses support the deck; layout impacts valley/hip framing.

steps.title: Deck/Sheathing
steps.caption: OSB/plywood deck fastened to schedule; nailing pattern matters.

steps.title: Edge Metals
steps.caption: Drip edge at eaves and rakes; correct lap and sequence.

steps.title: Underlayment
steps.caption: 2:12–<4:12 pitches require double underlayment; <2:12 use low-slope systems.

steps.title: Covering
steps.caption: Shingle courses; follow manufacturer listing for nailing and exposure.

steps.title: Flashings & Vents
steps.caption: Valley, step/headwall flashings, pipe boots, and ridge vent complete the system.
